scheme_name: Motivation Of Unemployed Persons To Start Self-Employed Enterprises Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Puducherry for at least 3 years
Applicant must be able to read and write fluently
Age must comply with existing bank norms
benefits_summary: Provides loans ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹2,00,000 with subsidies of up to 50% for projects up to ₹50,000 and 35% for projects between ₹50,001 and ₹2,00,000.
